1.text: “Ni ukuri, ni ukuri, ndababwira yuko uwinjira mu rugo rw'intama atanyuze mu irembo, ahubwo akuririra ahandi, uwo aba ari umujura n'umunyazi.

2.text: Ariko unyura mu irembo ni we mwungeri w'intama.

3.text: Umurinzi w'irembo aramwugururira, kandi intama zumva ijwi rye. Ahamagara intama ze mu mazina yazo akazahura.

4.text: Iyo amaze kwahura ize zose azijya imbere, intama zikamukurikira kuko zizi ijwi rye.

5.text: Undi ntizamukurikira, ahubwo zamuhunga kuko zitazi amajwi y'abandi.”

6.text: Yesu abacira uwo mugani, ariko ntibamenya ibyo yababwiye.

7.text: Nuko Yesu arongera arababwira ati “Ni ukuri, ni ukuri, ndababwira yuko ari jye rembo ry'intama.

8.text: Abambanjirije bose bari abajura n'abanyazi, ariko intama ntizabumvise.

9.text: Ni jye rembo, umuntu niyinjira muri jye azakizwa, azinjira asohoke kandi azabona urwuri.

10.text: Umujura ntazanwa n'ikindi keretse kwiba no kwica no kurimbura, ariko jyeweho nazanywe no kugira ngo zibone ubugingo, ndetse ngo zibone bwinshi.

11.text: “Ni jye mwungeri mwiza. Umwungeri mwiza apfira intama ze,

12.text: ariko uragirira ibihembo, utari umwungeri bwite kandi n'intama atari ize, iyo abonye isega rije asiga intama agahunga, isega rikazifata rikazitatanya.

13.text: Kuko ari uw'ibihembo, arahunga ntiyite ku ntama.

14.text: Ni jye mwungeri mwiza kandi menya izanjye, izanjye zikamenya

15.text: nk'uko Data amenya nanjye nkamumenya, kandi mpfira intama zanjye.

16.text: Mfite n'izindi ntama zitari izo muri uru rugo, na zo nkwiriye kuzizana. Zizumva ijwi ryanjye kandi zizaba umukumbi umwe, zigire umwungeri umwe.

17.text: “Igituma Data ankunda ni uko ntanga ubugingo bwanjye ngo mbusubirane.

18.text: Nta wubunyaka, ahubwo mbutanga ku bushake bwanjye. Nshobora kubutanga kandi nshobora kubusubirana, kuko iryo ari ryo tegeko nategetswe na Data.”

19.text: Abayuda bongera kumupfa ku bw'ayo magambo.

20.text: Benshi muri bo baravuga bati “Afite dayimoni kandi yasaze. Muramwumvira iki?”

21.text: Abandi bati “Ayo magambo si ay'utewe na dayimoni. Mbese dayimoni yabasha guhumūra impumyi?”

22.text: Icyo gihe hari umunsi mukuru wo kwibuka kwezwa k'urusengero rw'i Yerusalemu, kandi hari no mu mezi y'imbeho.

23.text: Yesu agendagenda mu rusengero, mu ibaraza ryitwa irya Salomo.

24.text: Abayuda baramugota baramubaza bati “Uzageza he kutuyoberanya? Niba uri Kristo utwerurire.”

25.text: Yesu arabasubiza ati “Narababwiye ariko ntimwizera, kandi n'imirimo nkora mu izina rya Data na yo irampamya.

26.text: Ariko ntimwizera kuko mutari abo mu ntama zanjye.

27.text: Intama zanjye zumva ijwi ryanjye, nanjye ndazizi kandi zirankurikira.

28.text: Nziha ubugingo buhoraho, kandi ntizizarimbuka na hato iteka ryose, kandi nta wuzazivuvunura mu kuboko kwanjye.

29.text: Data wazimpaye aruta bose, nta wubasha kuzivuvunura mu kuboko kwa Data.

31.text: Abayuda bongera gutora amabuye ngo bayamutere.

32.text: Yesu arababwira ati “Naberetse imirimo myinshi myiza yavuye kuri Data, noneho ni uwuhe murimo muri yo ubatera kuntera amabuye?”

33.text: Abayuda baramusubiza bati “Ku bw'imirimo myiza ntitugutera amabuye, ahubwo tuguhora kwigereranya, kuko uri umuntu ukigira Imana.”

34.text: Yesu arabasubiza ati “Ntibyanditswe mu mategeko yanyu ngo ‘Navuze ngo: Muri imana’?

35.text: Nuko ubwo yabise imana, abo ijambo ry'Imana ryajeho kandi ibyanditswe bitabasha gukuka,

36.text: mubwirira iki uwo Data yejeje akamutuma mu isi muti ‘Wigereranije’, kuko navuze nti ‘Ndi Umwana w'Imana’?

37.text: Niba ntakora imirimo ya Data ntimunyizere.

38.text: Ariko ninyikora, nubwo mutanyizera mwizere imirimo ubwayo, kugira ngo mumenye neza yuko Data ari muri jye, nanjye nkaba ndi muri Data.”

39.text: Nuko bongera gushaka kumufata, ariko abava mu maboko.

40.text: Avayo yongera kujya hakurya ya Yorodani, aho Yohana yabatirizaga bwa mbere agumayo.

41.text: Abantu benshi baza aho ari baravuga bati “Yohana nta kimenyetso yakoze, ariko ibyo Yohana yavuze kuri uyu byari iby'ukuri byose.”
